_description: Regression/benchmark cases for the Ollama PII-verification judge layer. Each case is what the judge model receives ({value, detected_type, context, source_layer}) plus the expected verdict this benchmark grades against. 'synthetic': true means the context was constructed to be faithful to a documented finding rather than copied verbatim from a corpus artifact (either because the exact surrounding text wasn't recoverable, or because the case is a generic sanity check with no specific incident behind it). 'source' cites where the case comes from. 'hallucination_watch' (optional) lists phrases that would indicate a model invented a justification not supported by the facts of the case (e.g. claiming a checksum was computed when the detector in question doesn't use one).
